spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact proposed surface from the explainer and the in-review Blink IDL (CL 8499040): DecisionModel, static availability/create, prototype decide/destroy/preference, with LanguageModel as the convention sibling.

interactive.rationale: Probe-again rebuilds the member table live; the real-call button executes the verbatim availability(schema) call and prints the genuine resolution or exception.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises member-by-member checks plus a real availability() call with polyfill detection; the page does exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles absent API (ReferenceError branch), present-but-drifted availability values (flags non-enum results instead of bucketing them), and polyfill providers; the enum read logs the browser's actual returned value per anti-regression rule 10.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5155080092385280, the explainer, and the implementation CLs the banner's flag claims rest on.

conformance.rationale: New 6-assertion suite mirrors the exact proposed members and the availability enum contract; verified executing 0 pass / 6 honest fails on Chromium 141, matching the page's absence verdict.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: probe table renders all-no, real call throws ReferenceError in 0.1 ms and the page displays it verbatim; console clean, no failed requests, 0px overflow both classes, screenshots read. Partial: the supported path (availability states, polyfill present) cannot be exercised in this container — no released build or installable extension here provides DecisionModel.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for the probe run, the successful-call branch (enum-validated), and the absent branch; console limited to two intentional lines.

design_system.rationale: Design tokens only; yes/no cells are emerald/rose on paper with text values; dark buttons set colour explicitly; [hidden] guard present.

accessibility.rationale: Table with caption and scoped headers in a labelled scrollable region, native buttons, single polite output for the call result, verdict carries its state in text not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness mobile 360×740 DPR3 + desktop 1280×800: 0px overflow, console clean; long member names wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere inside the scroll region.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the present path once a DecisionModel provider exists
openQuestions.detail: When a Chromium build with CL 8499040/8504264 (chrome://flags#decisions-api) or the WebAI extension polyfill is available to the verification environment, confirm the member table flips to yes, availability() resolves to a documented state, and the conformance suite moves off 0/6.

guidanceConsulted.query: built-in AI availability create monitor destroy conventions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Check availability() before create(); never call create() when unavailable; report download progress via monitor; destroy() sessions; treat model output as untrusted (textContent, not innerHTML).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The real-call section models exactly that order; all result rendering uses textContent; the availability enum is validated against the four documented states and unknown values are surfaced raw instead of mis-bucketed.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive capability table narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with scoped headers inside an overflow-auto labelled region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The member table uses caption + th scope + .table-wrapper overflow:auto with tabindex and aria-labelledby; 0px page overflow at 360px verified.

summary: Exact-surface probe plus a verbatim availability() call for a pre-incubation API. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container): all members honestly absent, real ReferenceError displayed, conformance panel 0 pass / 6 fail as the true platform state; flag guidance is sourced from the actual in-review CLs rather than guessed.
